hook.name: QuiverHookStaticFee
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for Quiver protocol token pools that sets directional LP fees (separate quiver-side and paired-side rates via updateDynamicLPFee), collects protocol fees by modifying swap deltas in beforeSwap and afterSwap, triggers LP locker reward claims per swap, and runs an optional MEV protection module during a 2-minute window after pool creation.
